## Innovate. Collaborate. Scale with Confidence.


In today's life sciences, diagnostics, analytical instrumentation, and medical technology markets, precision is no longer a competitive advantage. **It is a fundamental requirement.**


Whether your instrument depends on accurate fluid handling, advanced optical detection, or the seamless integration of both technologies, overall performance relies on achieving precise control at every stage of development. At IDEX Health & Science, we help OEMs engineer confidence into their products through expertise in precision fluidics, optical technologies, fluid management systems, and integrated instrument subsystems.


## Why Precision Control Matters in Modern Instrument Design


As scientific and medical instruments become more sophisticated, OEMs face growing challenges in maintaining system accuracy, reliability, and scalability.


The smallest variations in fluid flow, pressure, optical transmission, component alignment, or system integration can have a significant impact on instrument performance, sensitivity, and reproducibility.


Achieving consistent results requires more than selecting high-quality components. It requires a partner who understands how OEM fluidic systems, optical systems, and integrated subsystems interact within complex instrument architectures and can optimize performance across the entire platform.


### How IDEX Health & Science Delivers Value Across Fluidics and Optics


*This is where IDEX Health & Science delivers unique value…*


Our fluidics expertise helps OEMs optimize flow paths, improve system accuracy, minimize dead volume, and achieve precise fluid control in demanding applications.


Our optics expertise supports advanced detection, imaging, and analytical systems with components and technologies designed to deliver high performance, accuracy, and reliability.


Whether a customer is developing a fluidic system, an optical system, or both, our engineering teams provide the expertise and support needed to help bring innovative instruments to market faster.


#### Why OEMs Choose IDEX Health & Science:


- Improved system accuracy and repeatability
- Reduced development complexity
- Lower integration and commercialization risk
- Enhanced reliability and product robustness
- Faster time to market
- Scalable manufacturing and production support


The result is a more efficient path—from concept to market.


## Our Approach Is Built Around Three Core Principles


### Innovate with Confidence


*Innovation starts with solving complex engineering challenges.*


Our teams help OEMs model, measure, validate, and optimize critical system requirements before products move into production. By identifying key performance variables early, we help reduce development risk and establish a stronger foundation for successful instrument design.


From life science research and diagnostics to analytical instrumentation and industrial technologies, our engineering expertise helps customers develop solutions with confidence.


### Collaborate at Every Stage


*The most successful product launches are built on strong partnerships.*


From initial feasibility studies and prototyping through validation, verification, and commercialization, we operate as an extension of your engineering team.


This collaborative approach improves communication, accelerates decision-making, and helps identify technical challenges before they become costly delays.


### Scale for Commercial Success


*A successful prototype is only the beginning.*


OEMs need solutions that can be manufactured consistently, efficiently and scaled for production. IDEX Health & Science combines engineering expertise with global manufacturing capabilities to support customers throughout the entire product lifecycle.


Our commitment to quality, reliability, and operational excellence helps ensure consistent performance from prototype development through full-scale production of fluid management and optical systems.


## Your Single Engineering and Manufacturing Partner for Fluidics and Optics


As an OEM, you may be managing multiple suppliers across the development of your system. This fragmented approach can create communication challenges, increase development complexity, and extend project timelines.


By partnering with our team, you gain access to cross-functional expertise within a single organization, helping streamline development and improve execution for your fluidic and optical systems.

- Integrated fluidic and optical subsystem engineering
- Instrument optimization and commercialization support
- Custom OEM solutions for life science and diagnostic instruments


## Partner with the Experts in Precision Fluidic and Optical Systems


*When instrument performance matters, precision starts with the right partner.*


For OEMs developing next-generation analytical instruments, diagnostics platforms, medical devices, and life science technologies, IDEX Health & Science delivers the engineering expertise, manufacturing capabilities, and collaborative support needed to move from concept to commercialization with confidence.
